KEEP-float wraps around a floated, relatively positioned pull-quote box on its right side. The text flows beside the box and then continues under it, so every word of it stays readable to the reader even though the box overlaps the paragraph's own rectangle by a wide margin. That overlap is layout, not an overlay. More words keep the paragraph going so that it spans several lines next to the floated box and beyond.

KEEP-deco has a painted decorative layer positioned behind it with a negative z-index.

KEEP-share has a small share button absolutely positioned near its top right corner.

KEEP-raised sits in a stacking context raised above a painted box behind it.

KEEP-card is positioned text over its card's painted ::before background layer.

KEEP-scroll-1 is the first paragraph inside a small scrollable container box.

KEEP-scroll-2 is below that container's fold but the reader can scroll to it.

KEEP-scroll-3 is further down inside the same scrollable container element.

KEEP-under-cookie sits where the fixed cookie bar covers it at this scroll position.

KEEP-last is the final paragraph, far down the page below a tall spacer block.
